<REPO>/tests/fixtures/antipatterns/quality.html
  [tight-leading] line-height 1.00x (need >=1.3)
    → Line height below 1.3x the font size makes multi-line text hard to read. Use 1.5 to 1.7 for body text so lines have room to breathe.
  [tiny-text] 10px body text
    → Body text below 12px is hard to read, especially on high-DPI screens. Use at least 14px for body content, 16px is ideal.
  [justified-text] text-align: justify without hyphens: auto
    → Justified text without hyphenation creates uneven word spacing ("rivers of white"). Use text-align: left for body text, or enable hyphens: auto if you must justify.
  [all-caps-body] text-transform: uppercase on 285 chars of body text
    → Long passages in uppercase are hard to read. We recognize words by shape (ascenders and descenders), which all-caps removes. Reserve uppercase for short labels and headings.
  [wide-tracking] letter-spacing: 0.15em on body text
    → Letter spacing above 0.05em on body text disrupts natural character groupings and slows reading. Reserve wide tracking for short uppercase labels only.
  [skipped-heading] <h1> "Top heading" followed by <h3> "Skips straight to h3" (missing h2)
    → Heading levels should not skip (e.g. h1 then h3 with no h2). Screen readers use heading hierarchy for navigation. Skipping levels breaks the document outline.

6 anti-patterns found.
